CommunityApplications.Profile: This repository provides QBDL.Web, a self-hosted web application for downloading music with your own streaming subscription, from any browser or from its Android companion app. Source code, documentation and releases: https://github.com/Corrosive35/QBDL.Web. For help or to report a problem, please open an issue: https://github.com/Corrosive35/QBDL.Web/issues
